apps/frontend/public/f.js.review: Receiver aliases serve nested callbacks in compiled vendor code. Rebuild/replace from reviewed vendor source; do not mechanically rewrite aliases or expression statements. Pixel runtime/privacy/supply-chain review remains separate.

apps/frontend/src/app/(provider)/provide.review: Mount effect copies window.__PROVIDER_INIT__. Backlog: hydration-safe initialization and missing/changed bootstrap payload tests; the setter is not an authorization check.

apps/frontend/src/components/auth/after..review: loadCode executes after commit, not before binding initialization. Mount-only params/fetch and failure-loader handling need single-use activation/retry/route tests before refactoring.

apps/frontend/src/components/auth/provid.review: start awaits signer creation before setting QR state. Late signer creation after unmount needs cancellation tests before enabling this optional provider; avoid unstable start dependencies.

Initialization awaits adapter disconnect before setting connect. Adapter lifetime/stale-wallet dependencies require connect/disconnect tests; the setter summary alone does not demonstrate an authorization bypass.

apps/frontend/src/components/auth/regist.review: load runs after commit. Blindly adding dependencies can repeat a single-use code exchange because code is replaced with the resulting token. Backlog: immutable exchange input, failure and route/idempotence tests.

apps/frontend/src/components/billing/emb.review: Effects synchronize checkout secret/theme and a remount flag; coupon callback runs after commit. Backlog: keyed checkout identity, listener cleanup and coupon idempotence sandbox tests.

apps/frontend/src/components/billing/fin.review: Callbacks run from effects/polling after initialization. Backlog: bounded cancellation-aware polling and single-charge retry tests; no live payment validation performed.

apps/frontend/src/components/billing/fir.review: Effect initializes Stripe promise; nested JoinOver remounts on render. Extract stable component and test promise lifecycle in Stripe sandbox before changing payment behavior.

apps/frontend/src/components/billing/mai.review: Effects synchronize preview/period/channel selection; self-recursive confirmation polls after await. Backlog: keyed state, bounded polling and subscription sandbox tests.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/ad.review: t is referenced in a deferred async callback, not executed before initialization. Backlog: dependencies and failed/reconnect browser tests. Live OAuth remains unvalidated.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/ca.review: Effects reset selected channels for customer changes and copy fetched posts. Backlog: two-client filtering/draft-reset and optimistic update tests; no server tenant bypass confirmed at these setters.

editPost self-reference builds a reopen handler inside an async event after group fetch. Binding is initialized before user invocation. Backlog: stable closure and duplicate/reopen/client-switch tests.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/co.review: Mount loader updates after network response. Separate from Inbox. Backlog: prop/key changes, stale responses and edit/delete dependencies.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/cu.review: remove captures initial save callback in a deferred event; save uses current customer. Server scopes integration writes. Backlog: changed-input/remove/reassignment/dependency tests.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/he.review: Confirmed wrong publishing target: selected accounts are cloned, so reference identity incorrectly treats a valid channel as absent and replaces it with the first channel. Fixed ID membership, guarded empty lists, current dependencies and declaration ordering. Regression tests cover cloned/renewed lists and empty availability.
Confirmed stale callback/enabled bug from dynamic dependency lists. Fixed with literal dependencies and exact cleanup. Rerender/disable/unmount regression tests added.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/me.review: createPost self-reference constructs a reopen callback after awaited slot lookup. Deferred invocation occurs after binding initialization. Backlog: named closure plus slot/reopen/client-change tests.

apps/frontend/src/components/launches/we.review: Render reads the ref-held pairing word, also used for copy/polling. Backlog: displayed identity as lazy state and pairing lifecycle tests. No bot connection exercised.

apps/frontend/src/components/layout/chec.review: Self-reference occurs in delayed recursive polling after initialization. Backlog: bounded/cancellable polling with payment sandbox tests; no charge operation performed.

apps/frontend/src/components/layout/stre.review: Compiler disagrees on nullable primitive dependency. Backlog: explicit streakSince binding and midnight/timezone tests; this display calculation does not authorize requests.

apps/frontend/src/components/media/media.review: Effects reset search paging and selection; later setters execute after commit. Backlog: search/selection reconciliation and declaration cleanup with DOM tests; storage validation is separate.

apps/frontend/src/components/media/new.u.review: fileOrderIndex is instance-local inside Uppy useMemo and changed by callbacks; compiler flags async reset. Backlog: concurrent batch/failure/teardown tests before changing uploader lifecycle state.

apps/frontend/src/components/new-launch/.review: Effect copies delay text when popover opens. Backlog: controlled/keyed popover state and delay validation tests; downstream scheduling checks must remain.

Effects synchronize editor identity/loading; refs expose toolbar handles and callback snapshots. Backlog: committed handles/state and aborted-render/upload tests; diagnostics do not certify posting authorization.
Compiler propagates ref analysis through props passed to useImperativeHandle. Backlog: typed handle versus menu-data props, keyboard/index/loading tests; avoid broad editor rewrites.
